title: Onion Rings
description: Onion Rings are a classic Continental appetizer featuring thick onion rings coated in a light, crispy batter and crunchy panko breadcrumbs, then deep-fried until golden brown. They are best served hot with aioli, garlic mayo, or spicy ketchup.

ingredients.title: For the Onion Rings
items: Large onions (preferably sweet onions like Vidalia or Walla Walla) – 2
Buttermilk – ½ cup (or milk with 1 tsp lemon juice)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Onions
steps: Peel and slice onions into ½-inch thick rings.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Batter
steps: In a bowl, sift together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, pepper, and paprika.
In another bowl, whisk eggs with buttermilk and cold sparkling water.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, mixing gently until smooth.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Coating
steps: Place panko breadcrumbs in a shallow plate.
Dip each onion ring first into the batter, letting excess drip off, then coat evenly with breadcrumbs.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Fry to Perfection
steps: Heat oil in a deep fryer or heavy-bottomed pan to 175°C (350°F).
Fry onion rings in batches for 2–3 minutes until golden brown and crisp.
Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve Immediately
steps: Sprinkle lightly with salt while hot.
Serve with a continental-style aioli, garlic mayo, or spicy ketchup if desired.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with aioli, garlic mayonnaise, or spicy ketchup.
Pair with burgers, grilled meats, or sandwiches.
Enjoy as a crispy appetizer or snack.

chefTips: For extra crunch, double dredge by dipping in batter, breadcrumbs, batter, and breadcrumbs again.
Maintain the oil temperature at 175°C (350°F) for evenly cooked onion rings.
Rest the batter for 10–15 minutes before coating for a lighter, airy texture.
Serve immediately, as onion rings lose their crispness quickly.
